docs.purpose: The MaxBLD Help & Support page on maxbld.ca: what support covers, and one mail link per topic to the one operator-set support inbox (Spec 126 §11b.7 dated note 2026-11-11 item 3; §11b.3 dated note 2026-11-12). Until the inbox is set no link and no address is shown.
docs.data_story: This surface reaches **no API contract**: every word is a content key of its own content file, laid out by its page in the static page table. Its one value is a declared server read (Spec 128 §4 dated note 2026-11-11, FE-37): the support inbox setting in logic_variables (migration 313), read per request; the prefill (topic, query, lot) travels in the URL fragment and is read on the client.
docs.under_126: **CONVERTED** (MF-46 stage C): descriptor + content + the one web STATIC binding (Spec 126 §11b.1). It owns no component.

contracts: none — the page calls no API route; its one read runs on the server in src/lib/surfaces/maxbld-support.ts

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.
spec_refs: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §11b.7 W9 and dated note 2026-11-11 item 3 — Help & Support
docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §11b.3 (dated note 2026-11-12, MF-46: the mailto role and the inbox setting)

versioning.why: Nothing consumes it: a leaf page from content.

inputs.why: Server read only, no API contract (Spec 128 §4 dated note 2026-11-11, FE-37): the support inbox setting declared under config.

state.why: No store and no local state.

staleness.why: Rendered per request (force-dynamic): a new inbox shows at once.

session.why: Public on maxbld.ca: the public row /help → /parcel-tool/help; the page gates nothing (it never calls requireParcelToolPage).
evidence: src/tests/host-policy.logic.test.ts — the plain pages are served signed out

rls_class.why: One server read of a setting through the server pool; no user data.

checks.why: Spec 128 R-18: guards.session anon equals the host table's class for the page (the public row /help → /parcel-tool/help, public); the page calls no contract. Checked by src/tests/surfaces/auth-class-parity.infra.test.ts.

The footer (Terms, Privacy, Help & Support and the short legal line, ruling L-R3) is the same on every MaxBLD plain page and the legal line equals the search page's search.legal; pinned by src/tests/surfaces/static-page.logic.test.ts.

errors.why: A read that throws, an unset inbox or a value that is not an address leaves the mail links out (logged), never a 500; a defect in a committed file reaches the plain pages error boundary (web_maxbld_error).

emits.why: It calls no captureEvent and writes no ledger row.

metering.why: No usage_events write and no quota.

config.why: It reads the support inbox (an operator setting; unset or not an address leaves the mail links out).

logic_variables.name: maxbld_support_inbox
logic_variables.why: readSupportInbox: unset, not an address or a failed read leaves the mail links out (logged).

notes: MF-46 stage C (plan ~/Buildo-scratch/mcfrontend/MF-46/plan.md v3 §12 folds 16, 18, 22; operator round 2026-11-11 "1 y 2 y 3 ? 4y 5 y 6 y 7 y ... 8. y"). Dated 2026-11-12 (MF-46 follow-up, Help & Support contact; operator "All recommendations accepted ..."): one mailto part per topic, the inbox a server read (migration 313).

programme.why: The MaxBLD web front door (Spec 126 §11b.7 W9; business requirement 5): a plain page of maxbld.ca.
